excerpts: Rural Hospital Closures - Sheps Center. Counts observed 2026-09-17: 197 closures/conversions since Jan 2005 (109 complete + 88 converted); 154 since 2010 (86 complete + 68 converted); REH conversions excluded from counts. Inline methodology: OIG closure convention (stopped general short-term acute inpatient care); complete = no health services; converted = inpatient closed but other services continue; exclusions: merger/sale with continued inpatient care, CAH conversion, REH conversion, same-calendar-year close+reopen at same site; scaled-back inpatient (e.g. 70 to 2 beds) counts as open; relocation judged by community-access effect. Sortable hospital table embedded server-side: 197 data rows x 8 columns (Hospital, State, RUCA, CBSA, Medicare Payment, Closure Year, Number of Beds, Services Remaining), closure years 2005-2026. MEDIA line: terms of use on map data; interview requests via research team.
